list_child.name: list_intakes
list_child.desc: Retrieve the full list of counseling intakes currently on file, across every clinician and every stage of review.

get_child.name: get_intake
get_child.desc: Look up a single counseling intake record using its unique identifier and return its complete current details.

list_parent.name: list_clients
list_parent.desc: Retrieve the full roster of clients currently registered with the clinic, regardless of their active intake status.

get_parent.name: get_client
get_parent.desc: Look up a single client record using their unique identifier and return their complete current details.

delete_child.name: delete_intake
delete_child.desc: Permanently erase a counseling intake record from the system; this cannot be undone once it has been confirmed.

set_enum.name: set_intake_stage
set_enum.desc: Update the review stage of a counseling intake, moving it between pending, under review, cleared, and closed as the clinical process advances.

set_bool.name: flag_intake_risk
set_bool.desc: Mark a counseling intake as carrying a risk flag so that clinical staff review it with elevated urgency.

set_ref.name: reassign_intake_client
set_ref.desc: Move a counseling intake record so that it is associated with a different client rather than the one it currently belongs to.

send.name: text_client
send.desc: Send a text message to a client regarding their counseling intake, using the clinic's standard secure messaging channel.
